title: Prospectively respecified resource-qualified arithmetic isogeny pilot v3
proposition: Compare fixed ACSC-like and modified-MCJ arithmetic distance contrasts on a systematic fixed-stride subset of eligible conductor strata, with 1999 conductor/rank-stratified null shuffles and seven prespecified scale variants.
falsifier: A conditioned arithmetic-null statistic equals or exceeds the observed primary statistic, or the result changes under prespecified coordinate changes or independent implementation.

sources: SBX-2026-0006 v2 cohort_resource_receipt.json recorded 1,068,501 pairs exceeding frozen cap before executing its endpoint; v2 remains blocked; SBX-2026-0004 historical results not reused.

limitations: Systematically sampled 208 eligible conductor strata are not a random representative cross-section of all ecdata.
No observed cosmic data or physical mapping is evaluated.
The v3 exploratory protocol is fixed before v3 inferential execution, but independent preregistration and reviewer replication remain absent.
